name: CMC Foods, Inc.
old_description: CMC Foods specializes in the procurement, packaging and distribution of edible oils, vinegars and cooking wines. We operate under the principle of providing competitively priced, high-quality products with exceptional service.
about:
CMC Foods, Inc. is headquartered in Kansas City, Missouri, with additional facilities in Hot Springs, Arkansas, and Atlanta, Georgia. The company specializes in the procurement, packaging, and distribution of edible oils, vinegars, and cooking wines. While the founding year and ownership structure are not publicly disclosed, the business has established a multi-site operation to serve customers nationwide.

The company operates three strategically located facilities equipped with state-of-the-art filling equipment. Its service portfolio includes bulk tanker and tote delivery, food-service supply, custom labeling, and retail packaging. CMC Foods handles procurement through to final packaging, offering a full range of products that are distributed across the United States.

CMC Foods serves a broad customer base that spans from Fortune 500 companies to independent operators. Its primary markets include food-service distributors, retail chains, and food manufacturers that require edible oils, vinegars, and cooking wines in various pack formats.

The company emphasizes competitive pricing, high-quality products, and exceptional service as its core differentiators. It operates under nationally recognized, third-party-audited Good Manufacturing Practices and holds certifications from the Safe Quality Food Institute (SQF), the Orthodox Union (OU) for kosher products, the Non-GMO Project, and the USDA Organic program. These credentials underscore its commitment to food safety and quality assurance.

name: CMI ELECTRIC, INC.
old_description: CMI has provided electrical services to Delaware, Maryland, and Pennsylvania since 19
about:
CMI Electric, Inc., based in Newark, Delaware, has been providing electrical services to the Delmarva region since 1998. The company operates as CMI Solar & Electric, offering a blend of traditional electrical contracting and renewable energy installation. Ownership details and founder names are not publicly disclosed.

The firm delivers a range of residential and light commercial electrical services, including 24/7 emergency response, solar photovoltaic system installation, standby generator setup, and specialized aluminum wiring remediation using Copalum connectors. Additional services cover wiring for appliances, EV chargers, lighting upgrades, and underground cable work. All work is performed under full licensure and insurance, using only UL-listed materials.

CMI serves homeowners, businesses, and solar program participants across Delaware, Maryland, and Pennsylvania. Its customer base includes participants in the Delaware Green Energy Program and members of solar industry associations such as NABCEP, ASES, and MSEIA. The company also supports energy-efficient lighting retrofits for interior and exterior applications.

The company emphasizes customer satisfaction and safety, highlighting its round-the-clock emergency availability and adherence to code-compliant practices. Its differentiation rests on the combination of licensed electrical expertise with certified solar installation capabilities, allowing a single contractor to handle both conventional and renewable energy needs.

name: CMI Plastics
old_description: From custom shipping trays to protective product packaging, our experienced team specializes in packaging solutions with fast turnaround times.
about:
CMI Plastics operates from Ayden, North Carolina, where it was founded in 1939. The company remains a third-generation family-owned business, having grown from a local packaging operation into a custom thermoforming specialist with a national footprint.

The firm designs and manufactures custom thermoformed packaging — blister packs, clamshells, trays, and protective shipping solutions — using in-house tooling, CAM-driven design, and automated production lines. A 60,000-square-foot expansion at its Ayden facility added capacity for high-speed manufacturing, while rapid prototyping delivers physical samples in days rather than weeks.

CMI serves automotive and industrial, consumer products, food, and medical/pharmaceutical markets. Its customer base includes brands such as R.J. Reynolds Vapor, recognized as a Most Valuable Partner, and the company has earned repeated honors from the Society of Plastics Engineers for packaging design and environmental impact.

The company emphasizes full in-house control — from concept rendering through tooling fabrication to final inspection — supported by robotics and a sustainability program that incorporates recycled resins. Leadership cites its hands-on, multi-generational approach and a quality policy guided by certifications as the foundation for consistent, cost-effective packaging solutions.

name: CO Lumber & Real Wood Furniture
old_description: Founded in 1981, CO Lumber began as a humble unfinished furniture store with a one-person woodworking shop and a simple mission: build quality products and ensure every customer received exactly what they envisioned. That commitment to craftsmanship and personalized service quickly earned the trust of homeowners, contractors, and woodworkers throughout the community.
about:
CO Lumber & Real Wood Furniture operates from Colorado Springs, Colorado, where it was founded in 1981 as a modest unfinished furniture store with a one‑person woodworking shop. The business has remained locally owned and operated throughout its history, expanding in 2001 by joining forces with Rocky Mountain Cabinets, a fellow Colorado Springs cabinet maker that shared its focus on craftsmanship and customer satisfaction.

Today the company functions as both a major hardwood retailer and a custom woodworking facility, describing itself as one of the largest such operations in El Paso County. Its shop produces custom cabinetry, architectural millwork, live‑edge slab furniture, and other made‑to‑order wood products, while its showroom and lumber yard stock domestic and exotic hardwoods, softwoods, plywood, mouldings, and a wide selection of finished and unfinished furniture, including Amish‑crafted pieces. The facility also offers a complimentary cut‑to‑size service on sheet goods.

The customer base spans homeowners, contractors, woodworkers, builders, remodelers, interior designers, and craftsmen. Builders and remodelers source cabinetry and millwork for residential projects; woodworkers and hobbyists purchase lumber, plywood, and live‑edge slabs for custom projects; and homeowners buy finished furniture or commission bespoke pieces. The company notes that its custom woodworking shop serves enthusiasts, homeowners needing specific furniture, and businesses seeking unique pieces for their spaces.

The founding mission — to build quality products and ensure every customer receives exactly what they envisioned — remains the stated differentiator. Leadership emphasizes that owner‑operated status allows personalized attention, expert guidance, and a commitment to craftsmanship that has earned the trust of the local building and woodworking community over four decades.

name: CTAC Solutions | Colorado Telephone and Cable
old_description: We provide reliable, scalable telecom solutions that enhance communication and boost efficiency for businesses and individuals alike.
about:
CTAC Solutions, based in Aurora, Colorado, has served the Denver metropolitan area since 1996. Founded as Colorado Telephone and Cable, the family-owned, minority- and women-owned business rebranded in 2024 to reflect its expanded portfolio. The company is led by Eric Williams, who serves as engineer and CEO, alongside lead field engineer Nathan Williams and administrator Tamara Williams.

The firm delivers end-to-end telecommunications and IT infrastructure services. As an authorized Avaya partner since the brand's inception, it designs and installs business phone systems ranging from traditional voice to advanced VoIP platforms. Its low-voltage division handles structured cabling — including Cat6 and Cat6A — for voice, data, audio, and video across commercial buildings. A partnership with Uniview supplies surveillance cameras, DVRs, and NVRs with remote monitoring via desktop and mobile apps. Additional offerings include telephone system management, carrier optimization, network connectivity planning, IoT device management, and technology consulting. The team reports more than 1,000 completed projects and over 500 clients across 25-plus years.

Clients span small startups to large enterprises throughout the Denver metro region, including Centennial, Littleton, Westminster, Boulder, and Parker. The company also supports individual customers and has assisted telecom technicians in other states with troubleshooting. Long-term relationships are common; one client cited over 20 years of continuous service for telephone equipment and repair.

CTAC Solutions emphasizes a customer-centric model that promises direct human support without automated phone trees. The 2024 rebrand marked a shift from a traditional telecom provider to a full-spectrum solutions partner, aiming to deliver scalable, future-ready technology with minimal disruption during installation and maintenance.

about:
CTI Industrial Supply was founded in 1987 in Las Vegas, Nevada, and has since expanded to a second retail location in Richardson, Texas. The company began as a distributor of industrial, safety, and auto body supplies, later adding auto paint and car care products to its lineup.

Today the business operates both brick‑and‑mortar stores and an e‑commerce site stocking more than 10,000 SKUs. Its catalog spans adhesives, tapes, lubricants, woodworking supplies, custom paint tinting, and detailing chemicals, sourced from brands such as Luxfer, Mohawk, AutoMagic, Presta, and U‑Pol. The company also offers its own CTI‑branded tools alongside OEM lines.

Customers include auto body shops, industrial maintenance teams, woodworking shops, and professional detailers who rely on the distributor for safety equipment, refinishing materials, and specialty coatings. The Richardson location serves the Dallas‑Fort Worth metro area while the Las Vegas headquarters covers the Southwest.

CTI emphasizes breadth of inventory and personal service: staff are available to walk buyers through the online catalog or recommend products for specific applications, and the company promotes competitive pricing on both OEM and private‑label items.

name: CUE of Wv America-Beckley
old_description: C.U.E. specializes in custom molding urethane parts.  From small single runs to high-volume lines in custom work cells, C.U.E. can be your urethane molding partner.
about:
C.U.E., Inc. is a privately held custom urethane molding company headquartered in Mt Hope, West Virginia. The business traces its roots to 1957 and has grown to operate three manufacturing facilities, including a location in Dallas, Texas serving the oil and gas sector.

The company specializes in cast urethane molding, producing custom parts from single prototypes to high-volume runs in dedicated work cells. Its capabilities include dual-durometer multi-compound molding, bonding urethane to metal inserts, net-shape molding, and product development with 3D CAD design and prototyping. C.U.E. processes more than 3 million pounds of urethane annually and employs over 100 people across its facilities.

C.U.E. serves the corrugated paper industry as a major manufacturer of urethane anvil covers, as well as mining and aggregate, oil and gas drilling, metal forming, highway maintenance, and plastics distribution and fabrication industries. Its product lines include Hardliner® abrasion-resistant mining products and Dura-Trax® highway maintenance products.

The company emphasizes its team of mechanical, chemical, and industrial engineers and ISO 9001:2015 certification to take products from concept to market through integrated design services and custom manufacturing cells.

about:
Cable & Connections was founded in 1997 in West Columbia, South Carolina. The company operates as a distributor of connectivity and infrastructure products, serving businesses across the Southeast and nationally through its e-commerce platform.

The company stocks a broad catalog that includes networking patch cables, fiber assemblies and breakouts, audio/video keystones and faceplates, security and access control equipment, cable management accessories, rack shelves and mounts, test equipment, and tools. It carries brands such as Vertical Cable, VMP, and ProdataKey, and promotes itself as holding the largest inventory of Vertical Cable products. The online store organizes offerings into categories ranging from bulk wire and conduit to industrial cable and LED lighting.

Customers include low-voltage contractors, IT integrators, security installers, A/V professionals, and facility managers who need reliable, in-stock components for commercial and industrial projects. The company also offers a business account program with volume pricing and an affiliate program for partners.

Cable & Connections emphasizes its long-standing presence with the tagline “Keeping You Connected Since 1997” and highlights closeout deals on equipment mounts and shelves as a way to reduce project costs.

about:
Cable Assembly, LLC was founded in 1988 in Whitsett, North Carolina. The company operates from a facility and has grown into a preferred supplier for multinational customers, including numerous Fortune 500 companies.

The company specializes in wire harness and electro-mechanical assembly, offering services such as ink jet marking, hot stamping, Kanban/JIT inventory management, first article inspection, and full production runs. Engineering support includes design development from prototype to production, with capabilities spanning virtually every industry.

Cable Assembly serves industries including steam turbines, industrial equipment, HVAC equipment, fuel dispensers, point-of-sale systems, material handling equipment, construction and mining equipment, generators and air compressors, and energy management control. Its customer base includes Fortune 500 companies and multinational corporations across these sectors.

The company emphasizes its Certified LEAN Enterprise status, ISO 9001:2015 certification, UL and CSA recognition, and participation in the Tyco Electronics ACES program as key differentiators. Its reputation is built on engineering-driven responsiveness, reliability, resourcefulness, and total customer satisfaction.

about:
Cable Connection Inc., a BizLink Company, operates from Fremont, California. Founded in 1996 in Los Gatos, the business began as a custom cable assembly supplier and later acquired Wilco Wire Technology, moving its headquarters to Fremont. The company is a subsidiary of BizLink Technology Inc.

The company manufactures wire harnesses, cable assemblies, box builds, and electro-mechanical assemblies, offering design and engineering, new product introduction, quick-turn prototyping, and full production support. Its capabilities include insert and over-molding, micro CNC machining, cable braiding, and ultrasonic welding. The firm reports 30-plus years of experience, 300-plus customers, a 99.5% on-time delivery rate, and a 99.8% first-pass yield.

Cable Connection serves Fortune 500 companies across medical, automotive, agriculture, communication networks, industrial, semiconductor, and aerospace and defense sectors. Its product range spans electro-mechanical, coaxial, fiber-optic, RF, and flat cables, as well as custom power cords and integrated electrical-mechanical systems.

The company states its purpose is to make great products that enhance quality of life, with a vision to integrate cutting-edge technology and a mission to be the provider of high-quality cable manufacturing solutions. It emphasizes design-for-manufacturability expertise and in-house machining and braiding capabilities as competitive advantages.
